### Mission: Impossible - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/mission-impossible-one-year-devotions-for-men-april-19.html
Passage: Ezekiel 2:3
Points:
- Ezekiel received his calling in humble submission before the overwhelming glory of God.
- God's voice provided both the mandate and the spiritual power required to stand and obey.
- Ezekiel was assigned a humanly impossible task: proclaiming God's message to an obstinate people who refused to listen.
- Faithfully speaking God's word ensures that even a rebellious audience realizes God sent a true witness among them.
- Even when circumstances seem entirely unyielding, God remains fully in control and accomplishes His purpose.
